levels.vintage_status: latest retrieved history; no retained historical source vintages
levels.classification_continuity: Current raw official file directly carries current group codes and labels in 2015 and 2026. This is evidence of a current recoded history, not independent verification of an item-level concordance or historical real-time availability.
levels.tax_and_regulation_status: Raw national CPI service groups. No tax-first-round correction or CNB-core/regulated membership flags are supplied.

scope_notes.111: Catering includes restaurants, canteens and school canteens; not a restaurant-only history.
scope_notes.112: Accommodation includes hotels, recreation accommodation, school and university dormitories.
scope_notes.042: Imputed rent / owner housing costs; 2026 basket item is acquisition, reconstruction and maintenance of owner housing.
scope_notes.098: Package holidays; current subgroup 096 is cultural services.

weights.unit: per mille of total national CPI basket
weights.basis_year_relation: Each saved workbook header states constant weights for effective_year - 2.
weights.publication_status: Dates are the existing January detailed CPI release proxy, with February 15 fallback. They are not verified historical publication timestamps for these workbook files.
weights.intraday_note: Preserve the user-approved existing date convention: available at midnight Europe/Prague on availability_assumption_date, without imposing the 09:00 release hour suggested by the archived audit. These are assumed basket availability dates, not recorded historical publication timestamps.
weights.classification_mapping: For current 098, use historical basket 09.6 through 2024 and basket 09.8 in 2026. Strip optional E prefix. Other selected group codes are stable at this level.
weights.not_current_shares: Base expenditure weights in fractions of the headline basket after division by 1000. An aggregation using these frozen coefficients is a projected diagnostic, not an exact current contribution. Official current shares require appropriate prior-month price updating, origin eligibility, and scope/tax reconciliation; normalising the five groups does not give official core-services shares.
weights.selection_rule: Select the latest even effective_year no later than origin.year whose shared availability_assumption_date is no later than the origin clock, interpreted in Europe/Prague. Never borrow a future-year regime, even if published early.

broad_yoy.unit: percent year-on-year inflation (gross factor is 1 + value / 100)
broad_yoy.frequency: monthly observations of annual inflation; not monthly inflation rates

concepts.goods: Other tradables excluding food and fuel prices

broad_yoy.tax_treatment: CPI_CLE retains first-round tax effects; these concepts are not an exact partition of tax-corrected CNB core inflation.
broad_yoy.vintage_status: Latest retrieved history; no recorded historical observation vintages.
broad_yoy.availability_rule: Historical eligibility uses the existing detailed-CPI publication convention in the experiment; retrieval time is real, assumed historical availability is not an archived source vintage.
broad_yoy.core_monthly_fixture: tests/fixtures/cleanup/cnb_core_mm.csv (existing experiment source; not replaced by this snapshot)

services_proxy_audit.construction: Unweighted arithmetic mean of six broad division indices, followed by monthly percentage change.
services_proxy_audit.meaning: Contains mixed goods/services divisions, omits services in housing/transport/recreation and has no core, tax or regulation filter.
